items.title: iii) Motion of particles in solids

source_refs.note: iii) Motion of particles in solids: a main subheading of 5.11 General properties of solids, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 109-109.

blocks.text: The constituent particles of a solid do not undergo translatory motion, and neither rotational ones. They only vibrate about their mean positions. These vibrations become more intense at higher temperature.
